chapter: Later years and the Texas scene
title: Playing the Hemisphere world's fair
summary: Albert had to fight up to the congressman to get a spot, as the only Black performer to put on a show there.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Segregation on the road and the bandstand

blocks.x: You played that, didn't you? Yeah, but it was a hard struggle, Dick. Dick, I had to fight all the way up to the Congressman Gonzalez to get a spot in there. I was the only Negro that actually put on his show at the Hemisphere. The only one. Now there were one, there were individuals, single individuals like this, maybe one, two, or three. But for the size of the, of the world's fairs, it was supposed to be with one representation, not all.
And they didn't bring anybody in from out of town on their way?
No, not any Negro. Well, like I said, maybe one at a time. Oh, I see.
